text:
IT'S
THAT DOG
HE'S STARTED
A STAMPEDE-
I'VE GOT TO GET OUT THEY'LL KILL ME-BUT HOW? THEY'RE POURING THROUGH THE PASS AND THERE'S NO OTHER WAY OUT-

BUT AS THE INFURIATED
ELEPHANTS DESTROY ALL IN
THEIR PATH, CAMILLA AND HER
FRIENDS ESCAPE INTO THE
POOL

LEAVING THE DESECRATORS
TO CERTAIN DEATH-

I DIDN'T THINK WE'D MAKE
IT THROUGH THE GROTTO-
BUT WE DID AND THAT'S
THE END OF YOUR PARTNER
AND HIS HENCHMEN
I DON'T KNOW HOW I CAN REPAY YOU.

REMEMBER ONE THING, TRADER.
THE LAW OF THE JUNGLE IS
DEATH TO TRANSGRESSORS
NEVER PLOT TO ROB THE
JUNGLE OF ITS OWN.

YOU'RE RIGHT
CAMILLA NO
MORE GRAVE
ROBBING FOR ME
Camilla APPEARS IN EVERY ISSUE OF
